Hi everyone,

Recently I'm trying to play around with Codex, CC, and Lean/Mathlib. So I thought it would be more efficient to have a Mathlib MCP for these coding agents to obtain Mathlib-related data, instead of only asking them "Check Mathlib xxx for function definitions".

I have searched relevant keywords here, but most of them seem to be Lean MCP instead of Mathlib ones, so I was wondering do you have any good recommendations?

Thank you!

Edit: These are the only two I could find

https://github.com/KrystianYCSilva/lean-mcp

https://github.com/CriticalLine/lean-mathlib-docs-mcp
